title: Ensure 'Turn off downloading of print drivers over HTTP' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Internet Communication Management\Internet Communication settings\Turn off downloading of print drivers over HTTP to 'Enabled'
reason: Users might download drivers that include malicious code.

title: Ensure 'Turn off handwriting personalization data sharing' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Internet Communication Management\Internet Communication settings\Turn off handwriting personalization data sharing to 'Enabled'
reason: A person's handwriting is Personally Identifiable Information (PII), especially when it comes to your signature. As such, it is unacceptable in many environments to automatically upload PII to a website without explicit approval by the user.

title: Ensure 'Turn off handwriting recognition error reporting' is set to 'Enabled'

reason: A person's handwriting is Personally Identifiable Information (PII), especially when it comes to your signature. As such, it is unacceptable in many environments to automatically upload PII to a website without explicit approval by the user.

title: Ensure 'Turn off Internet Connection Wizard if URL connection is referring to Microsoft.com' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Internet Communication Management\Internet Communication settings\Turn off Internet Connection Wizard if URL connection is referring to Microsoft.com to 'Enabled'
reason: In an enterprise managed environment we want to lower the risk of a user unknowingly exposing sensitive data.

title: Ensure 'Turn off Internet download for Web publishing and online ordering wizards' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Internet Communication Management\Internet Communication settings\Turn off Internet download for Web publishing and online ordering wizards to 'Enabled'
reason: Although the risk is minimal, enabling this setting will reduce the possibility of a user unknowingly downloading malicious content through this feature.

title: Ensure 'Turn off printing over HTTP' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Internet Communication Management\Internet Communication settings\Turn off printing over HTTP to 'Enabled'
reason: Information that is transmitted over HTTP through this capability is not protected and can be intercepted by threat actors. For this reason, it is not often used in enterprise managed environments.

title: Ensure 'Turn off Registration if URL connection is referring to Microsoft.com' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Internet Communication Management\Internet Communication settings\Turn off Registration if URL connection is referring to Microsoft.com to 'Enabled'
reason: Users in an enterprise managed environment should not be registering their own copies of Windows, providing their own PII in the process.

title: Ensure 'Turn off Windows Error Reporting' is set to 'Enabled'
powershell_check: try { $a = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting' -Name 'Disabled' -ErrorAction Stop).Disabled; $b = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\PCHealth\ErrorReporting' -Name 'DoReport' -ErrorAction Stop).DoReport; if ($a -eq 1 -and $b -eq 0) { 1 } else { 0 } } catch { 0 }
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Internet Communication Management\Internet Communication settings\Turn off Windows Error Reporting to 'Enabled'
reason: If a Windows Error occurs in a secure, enterprise managed environment, the error should be reported directly to IT staff for troubleshooting and remediation. There is no benefit to the corporation to report these errors directly to Microsoft, and there is some risk of unknowingly exposing sensitive data as part of the error.
